# Wanjuan (万卷), derived from Pagekin (书童), formerly AI Novel Writer (AI 小说作家)

> Wanjuan (万卷) is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) desktop application for Windows and macOS for writing long novels and serialized web fiction with AI. It is derived from Pagekin by EthanYoQ and adds a Fanqie book library with recommender-style scoring and AI-driven book picking, multi-book setup fusion, a GitHub writing-skill marketplace, and a first-run guide. It guides a book through setup, story architecture, chapter blueprints, drafting, review, revision, and finalization. Books are stored locally, and users bring their own model through an OpenAI-compatible API, native Google Gemini, a local Ollama server, or a command-line agent they already signed in to (`codex`, `gemini`, `claude`).

Key facts:

- Platforms: Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS Intel (x64). Installers are published on GitHub Releases. The Windows installer is not code-signed; the macOS installers are ad-hoc signed and not notarized.
- Interface languages: Chinese and English. Each book's writing language can be Chinese or English.
- Model presets: DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, BigModel (Zhipu), OpenAI, xAI (Grok), Google Gemini, Ollama (local), NovelAI, local harness (CLI), and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The app does not provide or host models.
- Local harness: a third request path that spawns an already-signed-in CLI (`codex exec {{prompt}}`, `gemini -p {{prompt}}`, `claude -p {{prompt}}`, or any custom command) and reads its stdout, with no API key. Prompt goes through `{{prompt}}` substitution or standard input; token usage is not reported by harnesses.
- Harness detection: the settings page scans PATH (plus `~/.local/bin`, Homebrew, and the npm global directory), runs `--version`, and looks for known credential files to list codex, gemini, claude, and agy with version and sign-in state. One click fills the command and arguments, or opens `codex login` / `claude` in the system terminal. Detection is read-only: credential files are never read, only checked for existence and size, and no secret leaves the machine.
- Data: books live in the user's book folder and a local SQLite database. Model settings and API keys are stored in the app data directory on the user's computer (`%APPDATA%\ai-novel-writer` on Windows, `~/Library/Application Support/ai-novel-writer` on macOS).
- Workflow: library, setup, architecture (premise, cast, worldbuilding, plot outline), chapter blueprints, single-chapter drafting with AI review and diff-based revision, finalization, run sheet for generation runs, plot threads, knowledge base, version history, export to Markdown or plain text, local and WebDAV backups.
- Derived features: Fanqie library browses 19 male-lead and 18 female-lead genre rankings with covers, word counts, and chapter-title rhythm; picks two to five books and fuses them into a new setup. "Suggest a bundle" drafts a set deterministically; "AI picks" hands the candidate catalog to the model, which returns book IDs, a direction, and a reason, and fails loudly when it picks books outside the list. Every book and every set carries a 0-100 score built from recommender conventions: log-scaled heat, IMDb weighted-rating shrinkage for per-chapter retention, a Gaussian (RBF) kernel for pace distance, and mean pairwise Jaccard tag overlap for genre focus. The GitHub skill marketplace scans repositories for SKILL.md files, downloads referenced text, and rejects scripts or subagents. A four-step first-run guide explains model setup, sources, and writing flow.
- Novel breakdown and imitation: import a reference novel (.txt, .md, .epub); AI breaks down its structure, extracts its style, infers chapter blueprints, and produces imitation constraints.
- Installers are named `wanjuan-setup-<version>.exe` on Windows and `wanjuan-mac-<arch>-<version>-installer.dmg` on macOS. Attribution to upstream Pagekin is in NOTICE.md.
- Continuation: import an existing manuscript as finalized chapters and continue writing from it; in the prose editor, selected text can be continued, refined, expanded, or rewritten as dialogue.
- Rewriting: revise a whole chapter to the author's own instructions and selected review notes; the result is shown as a paragraph-by-paragraph diff for the author to accept.
- Writing skills: install prompt-only SKILL.md writing skills from GitHub (for example, a skill that removes the typical AI tone), review them before installing, and bind them to the planning, drafting, review, or revision stage. Scripts and tool requirements are not installed.
- Batch writing handles up to 10 chapters per run. There is no fixed limit on total chapters.
- The interface is a paper-and-ink desk with a light "aged paper" theme and a dark "reading at night" theme; the assistant chat entry is temporarily hidden.

## Earning with it

- Wanjuan does not pay authors and promises no income. It shortens the production path to the platforms that do: Fanqie, Qimao, Qidian, Jinjiang, Zhihu columns, short-drama and audiobook rights buyers, and ghostwriting clients.
- Typical routes: revenue share on free-reading platforms, revenue share on paid subscriptions, attendance bonuses and minimum guarantees, short-drama and audiobook adaptation, ghostwriting and studio work, and newsletter or subscription columns. Batch blueprints and batch writing carry a daily release schedule; the Fanqie rankings inform topic choice.
